mentions.description: boznz's next novel, which will be either science fiction or fantasy. The genre is not yet decided: it is currently a blend of both, but the author plans to lean heavily toward one genre for the final book, based on past negative experience with crossing genres.
mentions.problem: Undecided genre direction: whether the next novel should be science fiction or fantasy, given that past experience crossing genres was not great.
mentions.author: boznz

supporting.summary: jgilias suggested writing both genres at once ('Why not both?') in response to the genre dilemma.
supporting.author: jgilias

supporting.summary: boznz clarified that the work currently blends both genres, but because past experience with crossing genres was not great, the final book will probably lean heavily on one genre.
supporting.excerpt: That is what it is at the moment, but my experience from crossing genres in the past was not great so I will probably lean more heavily on one for the final book.
supporting.author: boznz
